changes: Remove redundant Send Back control: clicking a chart focuses its window.
Move semantic S-state/slope/HA/CCI capsules into the chart titlebar and remove redundant CoinGlass source strip.
Persist inspected HA price guide when clicking empty plot or bringing other windows forward. Clicking another HA stair changes selection; clicking selected price badge dismisses.
Move complete breathing live-price circle 17 units inside right axis and slow pulse animation from 2 s to 4 s.
Expand custom USDT PERP list cap from six to eight with no internal scrollbar. Move deletion from hover overlay to explicit Manage dialog to avoid accidental CCI activation.
Narrow both fixed market panels while keeping all 21 crypto and 12 stock rows visible.
Move four-chart taskbar farther right in footer and use released left space for actual 15M/4H/1D loading progress and connection summary.
Fear & Greed enlarged to a clickable overlay above every chart and footer; hover no longer opens it, leaving the overlay closes it.

Add a third fixed custom panel underneath the twelve US stock/commodity rows with a six-contract cap. Search Pionex Worker /api/monitor/symbols; only verified USDT PERP entries are offered while the online universe is complete. Offline partial mode offers clearly marked unverified candidates.

Custom contracts use the existing shared 15M/4H/1D OHLC, price and daily indicator pipeline. Custom list stays independent of original 21+12 entries; members persist in localStorage and can be individually removed.
Rename NOW label to 現價 and animate a cyan breathing dot on the actual live price horizontal line.
Render daily semantic capsules for S-state, middle-band slope, HA, and CCI in each chart window status strip.

Preserve selected HA staircase horizontal price guide across pointer departure and data redraw; only blank chart click or selection of another staircase changes the state. A new symbol clears stale selections.
Enhance crosshair and Bollinger band visibility around 30 percent.
Move four-chart taskbar into the bottom bar; remove the all-refresh and reset-layout buttons and redundant 33/33 status pill.
Retain the four draggable, individually locked/minimized, zoomable chart windows; independent sector sorting/flags/price bells.
